props.name: size
props.description: Font size in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color. The top of the fill is lightened automatically.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one fill cycle in the looping mode.

items.title: Loader Line Reveal
items.description: Thin lines draw across one after another, and the title and placeholder bars beneath each line wipe in behind it as loading completes.

props.name: title

props.name: rows

props.name: value
props.description: Progress from 0 to 100. Leave it out to run a looping demo animation.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one cycle in the looping mode.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the drawing lines.

items.title: Loader Jumping Dots
items.description: Three dots hop in turn, squashing when they land and stretching in the air, with a shadow on the ground that shrinks as they rise.

props.name: size
props.description: Dot diameter in pixels.

props.name: height

props.name: color

props.description: Text announced to screen readers.

items.title: Loader Dots Pulse
items.description: Three dots swell and brighten one after another, with an optional text label in front, for inline waiting states.

props.name: size

props.name: color
props.description: Resting dot color.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color and glow of a dot at its peak.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one pulse.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text shown before the dots. Without it Loading is announced to screen readers only.

items.title: Hero Dot Globe
items.description: A pure black hero with a huge canvas sphere of thousands of tiny dots that spins on a tilted axis, leans toward the pointer and carries a bright belt drifting the other way. Sparse mono details frame a bottom-aligned headline and an install command.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline at the bottom left.

props.name: subtitle

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark next to the logo mark in the top bar.

props.name: nav
props.default: [{ label: "Docs", href: "#" }, { label: "Examples", href: "#" }, { label: "Kit", href: "#" }]

props.name: navCta

props.name: learnMore

items.title: Web Threads
items.description: A spider web strung to the edges with a knot in the middle. Moving the pointer across a thread plucks it, and the vibration travels through the web before it settles.

props.name: spokes
props.description: Number of threads running from the knot to the edges.

props.name: rings
props.description: Number of rings around the knot.

props.name: color
props.description: Thread color at rest.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of vibrating threads and the knot.

props.name: pluck
props.description: How hard a crossing plucks the threads.

props.name: damping
props.description: How quickly vibrations die out. Higher settles faster.

props.name: breeze
props.description: Strength of the gentle idle sway. 0 keeps the web still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the web layout.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the idle path and sway.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the web.

items.title: Crystal Ball
items.description: A faceted low-poly sphere drawn on canvas. It turns slowly, tilts toward the pointer and moves its highlights with it.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. The ball never grows past its parent.

props.name: accent
props.description: Hex color of the facets and the glow behind the ball.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the idle rotation speed.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the ball leans toward the pointer. 0 turns the tilt off.

props.name: detail
props.description: Subdivision level: 0 has 20 facets, 1 has 80, 2 has 320.

items.title: Edge Gradual Blur
items.description: An overlay for the edge of a container that blurs the content under it a little more with every pixel, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge of the parent the blur sits on. The parent needs position: relative.

props.name: height
props.description: Size of the blurred band along its axis. Numbers are pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: Multiplier for the blur radius of every layer.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of stacked blur layers, from 2 to 10. More layers give a smoother ramp.

props.name: tint
props.description: Optional color that the band fades into, usually the background of the parent.

items.usage: {content}

items.title: Logo Loop Belt
items.description: An endless belt of wordmark chips with faded edges. It slows down or stops on hover and can run a second row in the opposite direction.

props.name: logos
props.description: Wordmarks to show. Each one gets a small mark and its own type style.

props.name: speed
props.description: Belt speed in pixels per second.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of the first row. The second row runs the other way.

props.name: hoverSpeed
props.description: Speed multiplier while the pointer is over the belt. 0 stops it, 1 keeps it unchanged.

props.name: secondRow
props.description: Add a second row in the opposite direction with the names shifted.

props.name: fade
props.description: Width in pixels of the faded edges.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between chips in pixels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the marks and the hover highlight.

items.title: Border Star Orbit
items.description: A card whose border carries a glowing four-point star that circles the perimeter, dragging a trail of fading color behind it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card in pixels. The star follows the same curve.

props.name: starSize
props.description: Size of the star in pixels. The trail scales with it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the star takes to complete one lap.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the star glow and the start of the trail.

props.name: trailColor
props.description: Color the trail fades into.

props.name: trail
props.description: Number of trail dots, from 0 to 30.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Freeze the star while the pointer is over the card.

items.title: Jelly Radio
items.description: A radio group whose selected dot squashes and stretches like jelly when it is chosen, while the label slides over. Arrow keys work out of the box.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: The choices to show.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when the selection changes.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. A unique one is created when missing.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the dot, the ring and the focus outline.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the radio ring in pixels.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stack the options in a column or lay them out in a row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every option.

items.usage: <RadioJelly options={[{ value: "a", label: "Monthly" }, { value: "b", label: "Yearly" }]} defaultValue="a" />

items.title: Spring Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose box springs past its size when checked while the tick draws itself and bounces in. Supports a label and an indeterminate state.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. Pair with onCheckedChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state on every toggle.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Show a dash instead of the tick, for parent checkboxes with mixed children.

props.name: label
props.description: Text next to the box. Clicking it toggles the checkbox.

props.name: description
props.description: Smaller helper text under the label.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill color of the box and the focus ring.

props.name: size
props.description: Box size in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the checkbox.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of the underlying input.

props.name: value
props.description: Form value of the underlying input.

items.usage: <CheckboxSpring label="Remind me tomorrow" defaultChecked onCheckedChange={(on) => console.log(on)} />

items.title: Status Mark
items.description: A small status indicator whose outline morphs between a circle, a triangle and a rounded square as it changes between idle, loading, success, warning and error.

props.name: status
props.description: Current status. Changing it plays the morph.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the current status. Overrides labels.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names per status. Defaults to Idle, Loading, Success, Warning and Error.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label as visible text next to the mark.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors per status. Defaults to gray, blue, green, amber and red.

props.name: duration
props.description: Morph duration in milliseconds. 0 switches shapes instantly.

items.title: Warm Tooltip
items.description: A cream tooltip with a soft amber glow that springs out of its trigger with a small arrow wobble. Opens after a delay on hover and at once on keyboard focus.

props.name: content
props.description: What the tooltip says.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. A single element receives aria-describedby while the tooltip is open.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side. It flips to the opposite side when there is no room, and auto starts at top.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the tooltip opens on hover. Focus opens it immediately.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap between the trigger and the tooltip in pixels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the glow and the border.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip opens or closes.

items.title: Branched Menu
items.description: A tree menu whose submenus branch out with connector lines that draw in one after another. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape work at every level.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu nodes. Each has id, label and optionally hint, icon, disabled and children for the next level.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled id of the selected leaf. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected leaf id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (id: string, item: BranchedMenuItem, path: string[]) => void
props.description: Called when a leaf is chosen, with its item and the ids from the root down to it.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the branches that start open.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the connector lines, selection and focus ring.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tree.

items.usage: <BranchedMenu items={[{ id: "new", label: "New", children: [{ id: "file", label: "Blank file" }] }]} defaultExpanded={["new"]} onChange={(id) => console.log(id)} />

items.title: Code Slots
items.description: A code or PIN display where every character is a vertical reel that spins and settles on its value, with a short glow when each reel locks. Changing the value replays it.

props.name: value
props.description: Characters to display. Changing it respins every reel. Characters outside the charset are shown as static separators.

props.name: charset
props.description: Glyphs the reels cycle through. Use letters and digits for alphanumeric codes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Spin time of one reel in milliseconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between the start of consecutive reels in milliseconds.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size in pixels. The reels scale with it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the lock glow.

items.title: Glide Select
items.description: A custom select whose highlight glides between options on a spring and whose arrow rotates open. Supports arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Escape and type-ahead.

props.name: options
props.description: Options with value and label, and optionally hint and disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the control and its list.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the highlight, focus ring and check mark.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start with the list open.

items.usage: <GlideSelect options={[{ value: "fra", label: "Frankfurt" }, { value: "iad", label: "Virginia" }]} defaultValue="fra" onChange={(v) => console.log(v)} />

items.title: Slide Commit
items.description: A press-and-slide control for destructive actions. The track turns from neutral to danger as the handle moves and locks with a pop when it reaches the end. Hold Enter does the same from the keyboard.

props.name: label
props.description: Text on the track before committing.

props.name: committedLabel
props.description: Text shown once the action is committed.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called once when the handle is released past the threshold or Enter is held long enough.

props.name: accent
props.description: Danger color the track fills with.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the track the handle must reach before release to commit.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Milliseconds Enter must be held to commit from the keyboard.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before the control returns to its start. Use 0 to stay committed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging and the keyboard hold.

items.title: Tech Readout
items.description: Text that appears like an instrument readout: letters flip through glyphs before settling, corner brackets and a tick scale draw in, and small mono labels fade up around it.

props.name: text
props.description: The main readout text.

props.name: meta
props.description: Up to four small labels: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Characters the letters flip through before they resolve.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time in milliseconds for the whole readout to resolve.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size of the main text in pixels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the brackets, ticks and unresolved glyphs.

props.name: replayEvery
props.description: Replay the readout every N milliseconds (minimum 1200). 0 disables the loop. Hovering also replays it.

items.title: Text Echo
items.description: Text with trailing echo copies that stagger in, fade out with distance and breathe slowly. Hover or focus spreads them apart.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to repeat.

props.name: echoes
props.description: Number of trailing copies, from 1 to 12.

props.name: distance
props.description: Pixel offset between consecutive copies.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of the trail in degrees. 0 points right, 90 points down.

props.name: fade
props.description: Opacity of the nearest echo. Farther copies fade from it.

props.name: spread
props.description: Multiplier applied to the distance on hover and focus.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between echoes when they appear, in milliseconds.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether echoes are filled or only outlined.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the echoes.

items.title: Depth Layers
items.description: Text built from many stacked layers that shift with the pointer for real parallax depth, with a shadow stack for volume. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to render in layers.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of stacked layers, from 2 to 24.

props.name: depth
props.description: Total depth of the stack in pixels.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum rotation in degrees toward the pointer.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the front face.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the body and glow of the extrusion.

props.name: idle
props.description: Drift along a slow path when the pointer is away.

items.title: Text Fold
items.description: Lines of text that fold open like paper with a per-line rotateX and perspective when they scroll into view, then pleat into an accordion on hover and unfold again when you leave.

props.name: lines
props.default: ["Fold the page.", "Keep the crease.", "Read between lines."]
props.description: One entry per line. Lines never wrap.

props.name: fold
props.description: Fold angle in degrees used for the hover pleats.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between lines when they open, in milliseconds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Opening time of one line in milliseconds.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Line height in em.

props.name: shade
props.description: Darken folded lines for a paper shadow.

props.name: replayEvery
props.description: Replay the opening every N milliseconds (minimum 2000). 0 disables the loop.

items.usage: <TextFold className="text-4xl font-semibold" lines={["Fold the page.", "Keep the crease."]} />

items.title: Specular Button
items.description: A metallic, glass or blue button with a specular highlight that slides across its surface, a lit edge bevel and a subtle tilt that follow the pointer. A scripted highlight plays until the pointer arrives.

props.name: tone
props.description: Surface treatment. Glass blurs whatever sits behind the button.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum tilt in degrees toward the pointer. Use 0 to keep the button flat.

props.name: shine
props.description: Strength of the highlight, streaks and edge light from 0 to 1.

props.name: idle
props.description: Keep a slow scripted highlight moving while the pointer is away.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label. Icons and text both work.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Forwarded to the button element, including onClick and disabled.

items.title: Card Border Glow
items.description: A card whose border lights up in the segment nearest the pointer, with a soft bloom spilling both outside and inside. While idle the glow slowly circles the border.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the glowing segment and its bloom.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card in pixels.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Thickness of the lit border in pixels.

props.name: arc
props.description: Length of the glowing segment in degrees around the card center.

props.name: bloom
props.description: Blur radius of the bloom in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds the idle glow takes to circle the card once.

props.name: idle
props.description: Keep the glow circling while the pointer is away. When false the glow dims instead.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content, rendered above the glow.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Forwarded to the root element.

items.title: Bento Pointer Glow
items.description: A three-column bento grid where one cursor-following glow lights every tile border and surface. Tiles lift on hover or focus and swap their description for a secondary caption; built-in visuals animate on their own.

props.name: items
props.description: Tiles to render. Each has id, title, description, optional caption, visual and size.

props.name: items[].visual
props.description: Built-in animated visual or any custom node shown in the tile body.

props.name: items[].size
props.description: Grid footprint: wide spans two columns, tall two rows, large both.

props.name: items[].caption
props.description: Secondary line revealed on hover or focus. Falls back to the description.

props.name: accent
props.description: Glow and visual accent color.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one grid row in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Tile corner radius in pixels.

props.name: glowSize
props.description: Radius of the pointer glow in pixels.

props.name: idle
props.description: Sweep a scripted glow across the grid while the pointer is away.

items.usage: <BentoPointerGlow items={[{ id: "a", title: "Traffic", description: "Visits", visual: "bars", size: "wide" }, { id: "b", title: "Latency", description: "p95", visual: "spark" }]} />

items.title: Gooey Nav
items.description: A pill navigation whose active indicator is a gooey blob. Three blobs with different timings stretch and merge through an SVG filter as the selection moves. Arrow keys, Home and End change the selection.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Navigation entries. All items share the width equally.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active item. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial active item when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the user picks an item by click or keyboard.

props.name: accent
props.description: Blob color.

props.name: gooeyness
props.description: Blur radius of the gooey filter. Higher values merge the blobs more.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Forwarded to the nav element.

items.usage: <NavGooey value={tab} onChange={setTab} items={[{ value: "home", label: "Home" }, { value: "docs", label: "Docs" }, { value: "blog", label: "Blog" }]} />

items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider whose track bends toward the pointer like a rubber band while you drag and springs back on release. The thumb rides the curve with a value bubble above it. Arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End also work.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new snapped value whenever it changes.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Snap increment and arrow key step.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill, thumb ring and bubble color.

props.name: maxBend
props.description: Largest sideways bend of the track in pixels.

props.name: bubble
props.description: Show the value bubble only on hover, focus and drag, or all the time.

props.name: idle
props.description: Let the track wobble gently while nobody is touching it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the bubble text and the announced value, for example adding a unit.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Block pointer and keyboard changes.

items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A tilted spiral galaxy of thousands of twinkling stars with a warm core and dark dust lanes, turning slowly. The pointer shifts the depth layers and parts the stars around it.

props.name: stars
props.description: Number of stars, from 200 to 12000.

props.name: arms
props.description: Number of spiral arms.

props.name: twist
props.description: How tightly the arms wind, in radians from the core to the rim.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the outer arm stars and the faint halo.

props.name: coreColor
props.description: Color of the bright core and the bulge stars.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Vertical squash of the disk, from 0.15 (edge-on) to 1 (face-on).

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the depth layers shift with the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far stars move aside around the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Rotation and twinkle speed multiplier.

props.name: seed
props.description: Integer seed for the star layout.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the galaxy.

items.title: Dark Veil
items.description: A dark translucent veil of drifting smoke with faint colored light at its edges. The pointer lifts a ragged, glowing tear in it that stretches as it moves.

props.name: accent
props.description: Glow color inside the tear and along its rim.

props.name: edgeColor
props.description: Second glow color seen through the veil edges.

props.name: veilColor
props.description: Base color of the smoke. Hex only.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the veil where nothing lifts it, from 0.3 to 1.

props.name: tearRadius
props.description: Size of the tear in pixels.

props.name: grain
props.description: Amount of film grain in the smoke. 0 turns it off.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the smoke and the idle drift.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the veil.

items.title: Silk Threads
items.description: Dozens of long, thin threads flowing across the area in offset waves, with a highlight that slides along each one. The pointer combs through them and pushes them apart.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of threads, from 4 to 160.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of most threads.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of every third thread.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Wave height of each thread in pixels.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line width multiplier.

props.name: push
props.description: How far threads part around the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Width of the combed area in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Flow speed multiplier.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the threads.

items.title: Layered Waves
items.description: Stacked translucent waves in depth with gradient fills and soft crest lines, rolling gently. The wave closest to the pointer rises toward it.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of waves, from 2 to 9.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the front wave. Hex only.

props.name: accentTo
props.description: Color of the back wave. Layers in between blend the two. Hex only.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Base wave height in pixels. Front waves are taller.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the nearest wave rises toward the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: crest
props.description: Draw a thin light line along each crest.

props.name: speed
props.description: Rolling speed multiplier.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the waves.

items.title: Grid Motion
items.description: A tilted wall of gradient tiles with small charts and cards, its rows sliding in alternating directions. Rows under the pointer speed up and brighten.

props.name: tileSize
props.description: Tile size in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles in pixels.

props.name: angle
props.description: Rotation of the grid in degrees.

props.name: speed
props.description: Base row speed multiplier.

props.name: boost
props.description: Extra speed of the rows under the pointer. 4 makes them five times faster.

props.name: accent
props.description: First color of the tile palette.

props.name: colors
props.description: Other colors used in the tile gradients.

props.name: tileColor
props.description: Base fill of every tile under its gradient.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered on top of the grid.

items.title: Text Shuffle In
items.description: Every letter slides through a few other letters before it lands on its own. Plays when the text enters the viewport and again on hover or focus.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render. Screen readers get the plain string.

props.name: shuffles
props.description: How many other letters each letter passes before it settles.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each letter spends sliding.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay in seconds between one letter and the next.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Play when the text scrolls into view, or right after mount.

props.name: hover
props.description: Replay on pointer enter and on keyboard focus. Makes the element focusable.

props.name: replayEvery
props.description: Replay on its own every N seconds while visible. 0 turns it off.

props.name: charset
props.description: Pool the in-between letters are drawn from. Defaults to the letters of `text` itself.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the letters while they are still sliding.

items.title: Text Scroll Float
items.description: Lines of text whose letters float up into place in a wave as the element scrolls into view. Progress follows the scroll position.

props.name: lines
props.description: One entry per line. Each line stays on its own line.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far below its final spot each letter starts, in em.

props.name: spread
props.description: Wave offset between the first and last letter, from 0 (all together) to 1 (one after another).

props.name: start
props.description: Viewport fraction, measured from the top, where the element's top edge sits when progress is 0.

props.name: end
props.description: Viewport fraction, measured from the top, where the element's bottom edge sits when progress reaches 1.

props.name: loop
props.description: Drive the animation with a built-in loop instead of the scroll. Moving the pointer across the element scrubs it.

props.name: loopDuration
props.description: Seconds one loop cycle takes when `loop` is on.

items.title: Text Scroll Words
items.description: A paragraph that wakes up word by word, from dim and blurred to bright and sharp, as it scrolls through the viewport.

props.name: text
props.description: Paragraph to render. Screen readers get the plain string.

props.name: minOpacity
props.description: Opacity of a word before it lights up.

props.name: maxBlur
props.description: Blur radius in pixels of a word before it lights up. 0 disables blur.

props.name: start
props.description: Viewport fraction, measured from the top, where the element's top edge sits when progress is 0.

props.name: end
props.description: Viewport fraction, measured from the top, where the element's bottom edge sits when progress reaches 1.

props.name: loop
props.description: Drive the animation with a built-in loop instead of the scroll. Moving the pointer across the paragraph scrubs it.

props.name: loopDuration
props.description: Seconds one loop cycle takes when `loop` is on.

items.usage: <TextScrollWords text="Every great product starts as a quiet idea." className="text-3xl" />

items.title: Text Circular
items.description: Text set around a circle that turns slowly. Hovering speeds it up and spins it the other way. The center takes any content.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to place on the circle. It repeats to fill the ring.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest diameter in pixels. The ring shrinks to fit narrower parents.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Letter size in a 200 unit wide drawing, so it scales with the ring.

props.name: speed
props.description: Degrees per second at rest. Negative values turn counterclockwise.

props.name: hoverBoost
props.description: Speed multiplier while hovered or focused.

props.name: reverseOnHover
props.description: Flip the direction of rotation while hovered or focused.

props.name: separator
props.description: Text placed between repeats of `text`.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Copies of `text` around the ring. 0 picks the count from the text length.

items.title: Text Scramble Hover
items.description: Letters near the pointer flip to random glyphs and settle back one by one once it moves away.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render. Screen readers get the plain string.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance in pixels at which letters start to scramble.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Characters the letters cycle through while scrambled.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the scrambled glyphs.

props.name: resolveTime
props.description: Spread in seconds over which letters settle back after the pointer leaves.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the text inside its block.

items.title: Text Warp
items.description: A lens follows the pointer and bends the line: letters shove aside, grow and tilt with a smooth falloff.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render. Screen readers get the plain string.

props.name: radius
props.description: Reach of the lens in pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum push distance in pixels at the center of the lens.

props.name: magnify
props.description: Extra scale at the center of the lens. 0 disables magnifying.

props.name: twist
props.description: Maximum rotation in degrees, leaning away from the lens center.

props.name: mode
props.description: Push letters away from the pointer or pull them toward it.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the text inside its block.

items.usage: <TextWarp text="Bend the line" className="font-serif text-5xl italic" />

items.title: Text Fuzzy
items.description: Text with a flickering noise displacement, like a worn signal, that grows rougher while hovered or focused.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: baseIntensity
props.description: Displacement in pixels while idle.

props.name: hoverIntensity
props.description: Displacement in pixels while hovered or focused.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Vertical noise frequency. Higher values give finer scanline tearing.

props.name: fps
props.description: How many times per second the noise pattern changes.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft halo behind the letters.

items.usage: <TextFuzzy text="Static Bloom" className="font-grotesk text-5xl font-bold" tabIndex={0} />

items.title: Text Mask Reveal
items.description: Lines or words slide up out of an invisible mask with a stagger when the block scrolls into view.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render. In lines mode every newline starts a new masked line.

props.name: by
props.description: Reveal whole lines split on newlines, or single words that wrap naturally.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between pieces in seconds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each slide in seconds.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the first piece moves, in seconds.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Rotation in degrees each piece starts with.

props.name: once
props.description: Play only the first time the block enters the viewport.

props.name: loop
props.description: When above 0, replays the reveal this many seconds after it finishes.

items.usage: <TextMaskReveal text={"Slow design,\nfor fast teams."} className="font-serif text-4xl" />

items.title: Text Highlight Marker
items.description: Chosen words get a hand-drawn marker stroke that sweeps across them one after another.

props.name: text
props.description: Full text of the paragraph.

props.name: marks
props.description: Words or phrases to highlight. Matching ignores case and every occurrence is marked.

props.name: colors
props.description: Marker colors, used in order and repeated. Semi-transparent colors keep the text readable.

props.name: coverage
props.description: Fraction of the line height the marker covers, measured from the bottom.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between markers in seconds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time each stroke takes to draw, in seconds.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the first stroke, in seconds.

props.name: once
props.description: Draw only the first time the text enters the viewport.

props.name: loop
props.description: When above 0, erases and redraws the strokes this many seconds after they finish.

items.usage: <TextHighlightMarker text="Good copy is short and specific." marks={["short", "specific"]} />

items.title: Text Underline Draw
items.description: A wavy or straight underline that draws itself under the text on hover, focus or when it scrolls into view.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to underline. Keep it on a single line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Flowing wave or a clean rounded bar.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Draw on hover and keyboard focus, or when the text scrolls into view.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the line.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke thickness in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the line takes to draw.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: With the hover trigger, draws and erases the line on a timer while nobody is hovering. Disabled under reduced motion.

props.name: once
props.description: With the view trigger, draws only the first time and keeps the line.

items.title: Text Odometer
items.description: Each digit rolls vertically to its new value like a mechanical counter, with separators and symbols left in place.

props.name: value
props.description: Value to show. Digits roll, any other character is static. Columns are aligned from the right.

props.name: cycle
props.description: Optional list of values to step through automatically, ignoring value.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between steps when cycle has two or more entries.

props.name: duration
props.description: Roll duration in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Extra delay in seconds per column, starting at the rightmost digit.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description: Roll up from zeros on first render.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the digits at the top and bottom edge of each column.

items.title: Text Flip Words
items.description: A sentence with one slot that flips through a list of words in 3D while the line resizes to fit each one.

props.name: text
props.description: Sentence with {} marking where the word goes. Without it the word is appended.

props.name: words
props.description: Words the slot flips through.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds each word stays.

props.name: duration
props.description: Flip duration in seconds.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the flipping word.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Hold the current word while hovered or focused.

items.title: Text Fill Scroll
items.description: A paragraph that fills with color word by word, left to right, as it scrolls through the viewport.

props.name: text
props.description: Paragraph to fill.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Color of the filled part.

props.name: baseColor
props.description: Color of the part that is not filled yet.

props.name: startAt
props.description: Viewport height fraction, measured from the top, where the top of the block starts filling.

props.name: endAt
props.description: Viewport height fraction where the bottom of the block is fully filled.

props.name: idleLoop
props.description: Fill on a timer while the page is not scrolling, and hand control back to scroll as soon as it moves.

props.name: idleDuration
props.description: Seconds one idle fill takes.

props.name: resumeDelay
props.description: Seconds after the last scroll before the idle loop takes over again.

items.usage: <TextFillScroll text="Interfaces should feel like paper." className="font-serif text-3xl" />

items.title: Text 3D Extrude
items.description: Text built from a stack of shifted layers that forms a solid extrusion and tilts with the pointer.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: depth
props.description: Extrusion depth in pixels.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of stacked copies. More layers give a smoother side at a higher paint cost.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum rotation in degrees.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the front face.

props.name: sideColor
props.description: Color of the side. It darkens toward the back.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Soft shadow behind the extrusion.

items.title: Text Liquid Gradient
items.description: Text filled with soft color blobs that drift through each other, over a blurred glow of the same colors.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: colors
props.description: Blob colors. Every color gets its own drifting blob.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: glow
props.description: Opacity of the glow behind the text. 0 removes it.

props.name: glowBlur
props.description: Blur radius of the glow in em.

items.title: Grid Distortion
items.description: A fine line grid that bulges around the pointer like a magnifying lens, with a soft accent glow where it bends. Drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Grid cell size in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the lens in pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far lines are pushed outward at the lens center. 0 keeps the grid flat.

props.name: color
props.description: Line color away from the lens.

props.name: accent
props.description: Line and intersection color at the lens center.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the grid lines.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the idle drift and the breathing of the lens.

items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A field of short strokes that turn to face the pointer like iron filings around a magnet. Without a pointer they follow a slow swirl.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between strokes in pixels.

props.name: length
props.description: Base stroke length in pixels. Strokes near the pointer grow a little.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color away from the pointer.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color strokes take on near the pointer.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance in pixels within which strokes light up.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Strength of the idle swirl when no pointer is present. 0 disables it.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the idle motion.

items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A dense grid of dots that swell and scatter away from the pointer, then spring back into place with a little overshoot.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between dots in pixels. Grows automatically on very large areas.

props.name: size
props.description: Dot radius in pixels at rest.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot color at rest.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the dots near the pointer.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of influence in pixels.

props.name: push
props.description: How far dots are pushed at the center, in pixels.

props.name: grow
props.description: Extra size near the pointer. 1.8 makes the closest dots 2.8 times larger.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the idle drift.

items.title: Ripple Water
items.description: A dark water surface where the pointer leaves trails of wavy rings and a click drops a stone. Raindrops fall on their own while nobody is touching it.

props.name: background
props.description: Water color painted under the ripples.

props.name: color
props.description: Highlight color of the rings.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast rings expand and fade.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between idle raindrops when there is no pointer.

props.name: maxRipples
props.description: Most ripples alive at once. Older ones are dropped first.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the idle raindrop positions.

items.title: Liquid Ether
items.description: Soft pastel clouds that drift on a slow current and get swept along by the speed and direction of the pointer, leaving a colored wake.

props.name: colors
props.description: Hex colors of the clouds. Each color is used twice.

props.name: background
props.description: Base color under the clouds.

props.name: blobSize
props.description: Cloud radius as a fraction of the shorter side.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Opacity of each cloud from 0 to 1.

props.name: force
props.description: How strongly pointer movement pushes the clouds and how visible its wake is.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the ambient current.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the starting positions.

items.title: Topography
items.description: Contour lines of a slowly shifting terrain, like a living survey map. The pointer raises a hill that pulls the lines into rings around it.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the minor contour lines.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of every fourth contour and of lines near the pointer.

props.name: levels
props.description: Contour levels per unit of height. More levels draw denser lines.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of terrain features in pixels.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Sampling resolution in pixels. Smaller is smoother and slower.

props.name: lift
props.description: Height of the hill raised under the pointer. 0 disables it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the pointer hill in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the terrain shifts.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the terrain. The same seed gives the same map.

items.title: Light Tunnel
items.description: Glowing rounded frames fly out of the distance in an endless tunnel. The vanishing point leans toward the pointer.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of even rings, the rails and the core glow.

props.name: secondaryColor
props.description: Color of odd rings.

props.name: rings
props.description: Number of rings in the tunnel.

props.name: speed
props.description: Flight speed.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Base ring stroke width. Rings get thicker as they approach.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the nearest rings in pixels.

props.name: follow
props.description: How far the vanishing point follows the pointer, from 0 (fixed center) to 1.

items.title: Glitch Letters
items.description: A wall of monospaced characters that keep flickering into new glyphs and colors, with short glitch bursts along a row. Letters brighten around the pointer.

props.name: characters
props.description: Glyphs to pick from.

props.name: colors
props.description: The first color is used for most letters, the others for occasional highlights.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size in pixels. Sets the grid cell size.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Font stack used to draw the letters.

props.name: rate
props.description: How often letters change.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius in pixels of the bright area around the pointer.

props.name: dim
props.description: Opacity of letters at rest, from 0 to 1.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the letter sequence.

items.title: Button Spotlight
items.description: A soft light follows the pointer across the face while the border brightens near the cursor. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Dark filled surface or transparent surface with a border.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Slide Fill
items.description: Color fills from the side the pointer enters and drains out through the side it leaves, with the label color inverting in sync.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Outline button that fills with light, or an accent button that fills with white.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: idle
props.description: Plays a short sweep on its own while the button is untouched, so it looks alive before any interaction.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Glitch Hover
items.description: Chromatic slices of the label jitter on hover and keyboard focus, then snap clean when the pointer leaves. A brief glitch also fires now and then while idle.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Dark outlined button or an accent filled button.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: idle
props.description: Plays a short glitch burst on its own while the button is untouched, so it looks alive before any interaction.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button 3D Press
items.description: A chunky tactile button with a solid depth edge. It squashes flat on press and springs back with overshoot.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Accent face with a darker edge, or a light face with a grey edge.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: depth
props.description: Height of the depth edge in pixels. Minimum 2.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Neon Pulse
items.description: A neon outline with a breathing glow that quickens on hover. Each click sends a ring ripple out from the pointer.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Glowing outline on a dark face or a solid neon face.

props.name: accent
props.description: Neon color of the border, glow, text and ripple.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Arrow Reveal
items.description: On hover the label slides left while an arrow slides in beside it. Clicking loops the arrow out the right edge and back in.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Accent pill or a bordered transparent pill.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Stateful
items.description: Morphs from idle to loading to success and back. The width animates to fit each label and the check draws itself. Driven by a promise returned from onClick or by a status prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.description: Click handler. When it returns a promise the button stays loading until it settles, then shows success. A rejection returns it to idle.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. When set, the button no longer manages its own state.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Label next to the spinner.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Label next to the check.

props.name: duration
props.description: Loading time in milliseconds when onClick does not return a promise.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds the success state stays before returning to idle.

props.name: variant
props.description: Accent filled button or a bordered transparent button.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: successAccent
props.description: Color of the success state.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Copy
items.description: Copies a string to the clipboard. The icon morphs into a check and the label swaps from Copy to Copied, then reverts after 1.6 seconds.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: value
props.description: Text written to the clipboard.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Label shown after a successful copy.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before the button returns to its resting state.

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Called after the text was copied.

props.name: variant
props.description: Bordered, accent filled or borderless button.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the simulated download in milliseconds.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Small label shown next to the percentage.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label shown with the check at the end.

props.name: resetAfter

props.name: variant
props.description: Dark button with an accent fill or an accent button with a brighter fill.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Button Stacked Text
items.description: The label is stacked above an alternate label. Hover rolls the letters upward one by one to reveal the second line.

props.name: children
props.description: Resting label. Also used as the accessible name unless aria-label is set.

props.name: hoverLabel
props.description: Label revealed on hover and focus.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between letters in milliseconds.

props.name: variant
props.description: Bordered transparent pill or accent filled pill.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for the focus ring, highlights and the solid variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding preset.

props.name: idle
props.description: Plays a short roll on its own while the button is untouched, so it looks alive before any interaction.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it.

items.title: Loader Orbit
items.description: Three glowing dots travel around concentric rings at different radii and speeds, with a beating core in the middle.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the whole loader in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the outer dot, the rings and the core.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the middle dot.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for the outer dot to complete one lap. Inner dots are faster.

items.title: Loader Wave Dots
items.description: A row of dots rides a sine wave while a color sweep runs through them from the first dot to the last.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the whole row in pixels. Dot size follows from it and the dot count.

props.name: color
props.description: Resting dot color.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color each dot takes at the crest of the wave.

props.name: dots
props.description: Number of dots in the row.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one full wave cycle.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption under the loader. Without it, Loading is announced to screen readers only.

items.title: Loader Equalizer
items.description: Audio-style bars bounce out of phase with their own rhythm. Good for buffering, streaming and listening states.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels. Bar width and gaps follow from it.

props.name: color
props.description: Color at the base of each bar.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color at the tip of each bar.

props.name: bars
props.description: Number of bars.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption under the loader. Without it, Loading is announced to screen readers only.

items.title: Loader Ring Gradient
items.description: A conic gradient ring with a glowing head that spins while the whole ring breathes in and out.

props.name: size
props.description: Outer diameter in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the head and the bright end of the trail.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the faded start of the trail.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds per rotation. The breathing runs at a slower pace.

props.name: label

items.title: Loader Progress Stripes

props.description: Progress from 0 to 100. The fill animates to each new value.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the bar in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Start color of the fill gradient.

props.name: accent
props.description: End color of the fill gradient.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the rounded percentage above the bar, on the right.

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown above the bar on the left. Also the accessible name of the progress bar.

props.name: color
props.description: End color of the ring gradient.

props.name: accent
props.description: Start color of the ring gradient.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds for one loop of the demo count. Ignored when value is set.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption under the ring. Also the accessible name of the progress.

props.name: color

props.name: accent
props.description: Light end of the shape gradient.

props.description: Visible caption under the loader. Without it, Loading is announced to screen readers only.

props.name: color

props.name: accent
props.description: Blip color and the leading edge of the sweep.
